{{Quote|We have every reason to believe that the Believers&mdash;that is the name that has been claimed by the cult of dark side followers that has emerged in Cularin&mdash;are trying to stop the crystal from leaving the system.|Jedi Master Lanius Qel-Bertuk, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" />}}
The '''Pulas''' was a [[Color/Legends|black]], fist-sized [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] that radiated [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force energy|energy]]. Over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the Pulas was wielded by various members of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]], until it disappeared around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Ruusan campaign]]. The crystal subsequently lay abandoned inside a [[Almas Sith fortress|Sith fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the Pulas was rediscovered by a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] researchers who were exploring the citadel, and the [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifact]] was taken to the [[Almas Academy]], a [[Jedi academy]] that was located on the world. However, the facility's [[Headmaster/Legends|headmaster]], [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]], feared that the Jedi could not keep the Pulas safe from the clutches of a [[Believers|group]] of [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cultists]] who were active on Almas, and [[Gender/Legends|he]] arranged for the crystal to be transported to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for safekeeping. Though the cultists attempted to steal the Pulas while it was en route to Coruscant, the artifact was successfully relocated to the Jedi Temple.

==Description==
{{Quote|Recently, a team working deep within the Sith fortress, helping to clean it out, uncovered a black crystal with 40 facets. It radiates strongly of the dark side of the Force.|Jedi Master Lanius Qel-Bertuk, on the Pulas|<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" />}}
The Pulas was a fist-sized, [[Color/Legends|black]]-colored [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] that had forty facets. The relic radiated [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force energy|energy]] and was considered to be a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]].<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" />

==History==
{{Quote|No one knows who has the Pulas. No one but me. Every box is identical in shape and size.|Jedi Master Lanius Qel-Bertuk, on the effort to transport the Pulas to Coruscant|<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" />}}
[[File:Almas_Sith_fortress.png|thumb|left|250px|The Sith fortress on Almas]]
The Pulas was wielded for generations by various members of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]], powerful users of the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and it eventually disappeared around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Ruusan campaign]]<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" /> at the end of the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The crystal came to reside within a [[Almas Sith fortress|Sith fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], where it lay undisturbed for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" /> Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" /> a team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] researchers led by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kirlocca]] undertook an expedition into the depths of the Sith [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] and discovered the artifact. However, the [[Believers]]&mdash;a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith-worshipping cult]] that was active on Almas&mdash;learned of the researchers' discovery and were determined to claim the Pulas for themselves. As the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] were transporting the crystal en route to the [[Almas Academy]], a Jedi [[Jedi academy|training institution]] situated on the world, a group of Believers [[Skirmish in the Almas Academy|attacked]] the researchers and tried to steal the artifact, though the Jedi defeated the Believers and successfully brought the crystal to the [[School|Academy]].<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" />

The Jedi studied the Pulas, and while they were uncertain as to the exact [[Force power/Legends|powers]] that the crystal possessed, they recognized the relic to be dangerous, and the Believer attack helped persuade the Academy's [[Headmaster/Legends|headmaster]], Jedi Master [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]], that the Believer presence on Almas made it unsafe for the artifact to be kept on the world. Qel-Bertuk contacted the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], the governing body of the Jedi Order, and after some negotiation it was agreed that the Pulas would be transported to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for safekeeping. However, the Believers continued with their efforts to steal the Pulas. During the first [[Standard day/Legends|night]] the artifact was housed within the Almas Academy, a band of Believers broke into the school and attempted to seize the artifact. The cultists were again unsuccessful, and the group all committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] to avoid capture by the Jedi.<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" />

{{RPG|''[[Coruscani Dawn]]''}}
Realizing that the Believers would likely try to interfere with any attempt to move the Pulas off-world, Qel-Bertuk devised a plan to hinder their efforts, and he summoned [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] from across the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]] to Almas, assembling a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of over 250 [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]. The Almas Jedi obtained a large number of [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] boxes, and each box was loaded onto a different ship, with one box containing the Pulas and the others serving as decoys. Only Qel-Bertuk knew which vessel was carrying the Pulas, and he hoped that the Force-deflecting properties of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] containers would confound any efforts by the Believers to use the Force to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] which box housed the relic. Once all of the containers had been loaded onto their respective ships, the fleet departed from Almas and set a course for Coruscant. As the fleet passed through the [[Cularin comet cloud]], while it moved toward the edge of the Cularin system, a Believer-operated [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] surreptitiously pursued a ship in the fleet that the cultists suspected was carrying the Pulas. The Headhunter attempted to cause the purported Pulas-carrying ship to collide with a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] fragment, which would allow the Believers to recover the artifact, but the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] did not succeed with its mission, and Qel-Bertuk's fleet made it to the edge of the Cularin system and entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" />

The fleet eventually arrived on Coruscant, and the Pulas was transported safely to the Jedi Temple. However, the cultists incorrectly believed one ship that was carrying a fragment of the destroyed dark-side-imbued [[City/Legends|city]] ''[[Conkesta]]'' within its Mandalorian iron box to actually be transporting the Pulas. When the ship landed on the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]], the Believers attacked the vessel's crew and made off with the box, which they subsequently took back to [[Coruscant Believers base|their hideout]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant Undercity]].<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You had possession of the Pulas. It's an artifact of the Sith that was passed down for generations.|Jedi Mace Windu, to the Heroes of Cularin, if the players were playing ''Coruscani Dawn'' during Celebration II|<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" />}}
The Pulas was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and was integral to the plot of ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'', a [[2002]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. The adventure debuted at [[Celebration II]], a major ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan convention that was held in [[Wikipedia:Indianapolis|Indianapolis]], [[Wikipedia:Indiana|Indiana]],<ref name="Celebration II">{{SWArchive|url=community/event/celebration/f20020507|text=starwars.com @ Celebration II}}</ref> and the adventure contained different endings for those players who completed the module during Celebration II and those who played it after the event. During ''Coruscani Dawn'', the player characters [[Roleplaying game|roleplay]] as the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a band of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] who are among the spacers hired to assist with the transport of the Pulas. For players who played the module at Celebration II, the Pulas was contained within the Mandalorian box that was shipped to Coruscant by the player characters. During that series of events, while en route to Coruscant, the player characters were tempted by the dark side of the Force to open the box containing the Pulas, and on arrival on the planet, they disembarked on [[Platform 3107]] with the box. The players then attempted to recover the box that had been stolen by the Believers, and the players had the option of either leaving the Pulas's box at the platform in the custody of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Devan For'deschel]] or taking it with them as they pursued the cultists.<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" />

After the player characters confronted the Believers in the Coruscant Undercity, the Heroes of Cularin journeyed to the Jedi Temple, where they handed their box over to Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] in the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]]. Windu then informed the player characters that the box contained the Pulas, and he thanked them for their efforts. However, for players who played the adventure after Celebration II, the Heroes of Cularin transported a fragment of ''Conkesta'' rather than the Pulas itself.<ref name="Coruscani Dawn" /> This article presents the series of events faced by players who played ''Coruscani Dawn'' after Celebration II because the short story ''[[Felanil Baaks, Jedi Artisan]]'' indicates that the post-Celebration II storyline is likely the [[canon]] series of events.<ref name="Felanil Baaks, Jedi Artisan">''[[Felanil Baaks, Jedi Artisan]]'' indicates that the [[Heroes of Cularin]] are in possession of a [[Coruscani lightsaber]], an item that the player characters obtain only in the post-[[Celebration II]] ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'' storyline.</ref>
